hebrewText: יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְשָׁרְת֤וּ אוֹתָ/ם֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י גִלּֽוּלֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/הָי֥וּ לְ/בֵֽית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְ/מִכְשׁ֣וֹל עָוֺ֑ן עַל כֵּן֩ נָשָׂ֨אתִי יָדִ֜/י עֲלֵי/הֶ֗ם נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה וְ/נָשְׂא֖וּ עֲוֺנָֽ/ם

tokens.bdb: properly, heed; by implication, purpose (sake or account); used adverbially to indicate the reason or cause

As it is indeclinable, it is often accompanied by the personal pronoun expletively, used to show the connection.
tokens.explanation: asher — pronome relativo: que, quem, o qual, cujo
